# Registrant Prep

> Registrant Prep is a Canadian SaaS exam-prep platform for the CIRO Proficiency Model, the 9-exam standard that replaced the Canadian Securities Course (CSC) on January 1, 2026. The new model is administered by the Canadian Investment Regulatory Organization (CIRO) and delivered through Fitch Learning. Registrant Prep covers all 9 exams (CIRE, Retail Securities, Supervisor, Trader, and the others), with plain-English study guides, a free 25-question CIRE mock exam, and an AI tutor that cites the rule behind every answer.

Last updated: 2026-07-02.

## Key facts
- The Canadian Securities Course (CSC) was retired on January 1, 2026 and replaced by the CIRO Proficiency Model.
- The CIRO Proficiency Model contains 9 separate exams, each tied to a specific registration category.
- The Canadian Investment Regulatory Examination (CIRE) is the foundational entry-level exam in the new model and the most direct CSC successor.
- Exams are administered by CIRO (Canadian Investment Regulatory Organization) and delivered through Fitch Learning.
- Registrant Prep pricing is $29.99 CAD per month or $249 CAD per year, with all 9 exams included on every plan.
- Every Registrant Prep study guide and AI-tutor answer cites the official CIRO syllabus passage it was sourced from.

## Exams
- [Canadian Investment Regulatory Exam](https://ciroexam.ca/exams/cire): 110 questions, 120 minutes, Multiple choice
- [Chief Compliance Officer Exam](https://ciroexam.ca/exams/cco): 90 questions, 180 minutes, Multiple choice
- [Chief Financial Officer Exam](https://ciroexam.ca/exams/cfo): 90 questions, 180 minutes, Multiple choice
- [Derivatives Exam](https://ciroexam.ca/exams/derivatives): 120 questions, 180 minutes, Multiple choice
- [Director and Executive Exam](https://ciroexam.ca/exams/director-executive): 75 questions, Multiple choice
- [Institutional Securities Exam](https://ciroexam.ca/exams/institutional-securities): 100 questions, Multiple choice
- [Retail Securities Exam](https://ciroexam.ca/exams/retail-securities): 120 questions, 180 minutes, Multiple choice
- [Supervisor Exam](https://ciroexam.ca/exams/supervisor): 90 questions, 180 minutes, Multiple choice
- [Trader Exam](https://ciroexam.ca/exams/trader): 100 questions, 120 minutes, Multiple choice

- [Registered Account Limits 2026](https://ciroexam.ca/cheat-sheets/registered-account-limits-2026): TFSA, RRSP, FHSA, RESP CESG, RDSP, RRIF minimum withdrawal table, HBP, LLP. CRA-indexed figures with verify-flags where 2026 is pending.

## Study plans
- [30-Day CIRE Study Plan](https://ciroexam.ca/study-plans/cire-30-day-plan): Day-by-day calendar for the Canadian Investment Regulatory Examination across all 9 elements, with weekly mock checkpoints and rule-citation-grounded daily topics.
- [30-Day Retail Securities Exam (RSE) Study Plan](https://ciroexam.ca/study-plans/rse-30-day-plan): Day-by-day calendar for the RSE blueprint with retail-suitability focus and two mock checkpoints (day 21, day 26).
- [30-Day Supervisor Exam Study Plan](https://ciroexam.ca/study-plans/supervisor-30-day-plan): Day-by-day calendar for the CIRO Supervisor Exam covering branch-management obligations, account approval, complaint handling, AML oversight.
- [30-Day Trader Exam Study Plan](https://ciroexam.ca/study-plans/trader-30-day-plan): Day-by-day calendar for the CIRO Trader Exam covering UMIR, order types, manipulation rules, best execution, short selling, marketplace mechanics.
- [CIRE vs CSC Decision Guide](https://ciroexam.ca/study-plans/cire-vs-csc-decision-guide): If you started CSC before January 2026, this guide maps every CSC chapter to the matching CIRO Proficiency Model element and outlines a 14-day catch-up plan.

- [I started CSC before 2026 - what now?](https://ciroexam.ca/for/post-csc-candidate): If you started the Canadian Securities Course before its January 1, 2026 retirement, here's exactly what carries over, what doesn't, and the catch-up path under the new CIRO Proficiency Model.
- [CIRE prep for MFDA-licensed reps moving to securities](https://ciroexam.ca/for/mfda-rep-transitioning): If you hold a mutual-fund-only license and want to add securities licensing under the new CIRO Proficiency Model, here's the exam path, study plan, and credit map.
- [CIRE prep for university finance students](https://ciroexam.ca/for/university-finance-student): If you're a third- or fourth-year finance student looking to credential up before recruiting, the CIRE is the cheapest signal you can earn. Here's the prep path.
- [CIRE prep for career switchers from non-finance backgrounds](https://ciroexam.ca/for/career-switcher): Switching into finance from another field? The CIRE is the foundation exam. Here's how to cover the math, the regulatory framework, and the products without prior finance background.
- [CIRE prep for bank branch employees moving into investments](https://ciroexam.ca/for/bank-employee): If you work at a Canadian bank branch and want to move into the investment side, the CIRE is the foundation exam. Here's the path and how to use your bank's reimbursement policy.
- [CIRE prep for mortgage brokers expanding into investments](https://ciroexam.ca/for/mortgage-broker): If you're a licensed mortgage broker and want to add securities licensing, here's the CIRE path, study plan, and how mortgage industry knowledge maps onto the CIRO Proficiency Model.
- [CIRE prep for fintech product managers in Canada](https://ciroexam.ca/for/fintech-product-manager): If you build investment fintech products in Canada (Wealthsimple, Questrade, EQ, neo-banks), the CIRE is the cheapest way to internalize the regulatory model your product operates under.
- [Supervisor Exam prep for new branch managers](https://ciroexam.ca/for/branch-manager): If you're stepping into a branch manager role at a CIRO dealer, the Supervisor Exam covers the supervisory framework you'll be accountable for. Here's the prep path.
- [CIRE prep for advisors returning after a break](https://ciroexam.ca/for/returning-after-break): If your CIRO registration lapsed and you're returning to financial services, here's the path back. CIRE rewrite, lapsed-registration rules, refresh study plan.

## CSC to CIRE bridge
- [Does my CSC pass give me credit toward the CIRE?](https://ciroexam.ca/csc-to-cire/credit): If you passed the Canadian Securities Course before January 1, 2026, here's exactly what CIRO grants as credit toward the CIRE under the new Proficiency Model.
- [What changed when CSC became CIRE?](https://ciroexam.ca/csc-to-cire/what-changed): Side-by-side comparison of the retired CSC and the CIRE that replaced it. Format, length, scope, source rules, settlement updates, ethics rewrite under CFR.
- [How much of my CSC studying still helps for the CIRE?](https://ciroexam.ca/csc-to-cire/content-overlap): Direct chapter-by-chapter map of CSC Volume 1 and Volume 2 to CIRE Elements 1-9. What carries over fully, what carries partially, what was rewritten.
- [CSC fees vs CIRE fees: what changed in 2026](https://ciroexam.ca/csc-to-cire/fees-compared): Side-by-side cost breakdown of the retired CSC and the new CIRE under the CIRO Proficiency Model. Sitting fees, prep packages, employer reimbursement.
- [I failed the CSC. Should I rewrite or switch to CIRE?](https://ciroexam.ca/csc-to-cire/retake-or-switch): If you failed the Canadian Securities Course before its January 1, 2026 retirement, here's how to decide whether to retake the CSC (if eligible) or move directly to the CIRE.
- [Do Canadian employers still recognize CSC pass certificates?](https://ciroexam.ca/csc-to-cire/employer-recognition): If you hold a CSC pass certificate from before 2026, here's how Canadian dealer members and banks treat it under the new CIRO Proficiency Model.
- [How do I get my CSC transcripts after 2026?](https://ciroexam.ca/csc-to-cire/transcripts): If you need your CSC transcripts or pass record for an employer, school, or compliance check after the program retired, here's how to retrieve them from CSI.
- [Is the CSC still used for exempt market dealer reps?](https://ciroexam.ca/csc-to-cire/exempt-market-dealer): Yes. Exempt Market Dealer reps are CSA-regulated under NI 31-103, not CIRO. The CSC is still a recognized proficiency credential for EMD registration. Here's the path.
- [When was the CSC officially retired?](https://ciroexam.ca/csc-to-cire/deadline-2026): The Canadian Securities Course was retired by CIRO on January 1, 2026 and replaced by the CIRO Proficiency Model. Here's the confirmed timeline and what it means for candidates.
- [EMD vs CIRO: which Canadian securities career path fits you?](https://ciroexam.ca/csc-to-cire/emd-vs-ciro-career-path): Side-by-side comparison of Exempt Market Dealer (EMD) reps and CIRO-registered representatives. Different regulators, different proficiency, different products, different career outcomes.
- [EMPE vs CSC for EMD reps: which exam should you write?](https://ciroexam.ca/csc-to-cire/empe-vs-csc-for-emds): Direct comparison of the Exempt Market Products Exam (EMPE) and the Canadian Securities Course (CSC) for new Exempt Market Dealer representatives. Cost, scope, time, future-proofing.
- [MIC sales rep registration: proficiency requirements + path](https://ciroexam.ca/csc-to-cire/mic-rep-registration): What proficiency a Mortgage Investment Corporation sales rep needs in Canada, why MIC distribution falls under EMD registration, and how the CSC + EMPE path applies.
- [How much does EMD registration cost in Canada?](https://ciroexam.ca/csc-to-cire/emd-registration-cost): Real cost breakdown for a new Exempt Market Dealer (EMD) representative in Canada. CSA registration fees, proficiency exam costs (CSC vs EMPE), prep packages, and firm-level fees.

## Login helpers (Canadian securities portals)
- [Login helpers index](https://ciroexam.ca/login): Direct sign-in URLs and troubleshooting for CSI, the legacy CSC, MFDA CERTS (now under CIRO), IFSE Institute, the CIRO surfaces, and the most-searched variants.
- [CSI Login: Canadian Securities Institute](https://ciroexam.ca/login/csi-login): Direct link to the Canadian Securities Institute (csi.ca) student login, plus what to do if you can't sign in. Covers CSC, CIRE and CSI designation portals. Official login: https://www.csi.ca/student/en_ca/logon/login.xhtml
- [CSC Login: Canadian Securities Course Sign-In](https://ciroexam.ca/login/csc-login): The Canadian Securities Course is hosted on csi.ca. Direct login link, plus what changed when CIRO retired the CSC and replaced it with the CIRE in 2026. Official login: https://www.csi.ca/student/en_ca/logon/login.xhtml
- [MFDA CERTS Login (now CIRO CE)](https://ciroexam.ca/login/mfda-certs-login): The MFDA CERTS portal moved to CIRO when MFDA merged with IIROC in 2023. Here's the current CERTS login path for MFD continuing education credits. Official login: https://www.ciro.ca/registered-individuals/continuing-education/mutual-fund-dealer-mfd-continuing-education-ce-program
- [IFSE Login: IFSE Institute Sign-In](https://ciroexam.ca/login/ifse-login): IFSE Institute student login plus what changed when IFSE began its CSI transition in March 2025. Covers the Canadian Investment Funds Course (IFIC) and LLQP. Official login: https://www.ifse.ca/login/
- [MyCSI Login: My CSI Account Sign-In](https://ciroexam.ca/login/my-csi-login): MyCSI is the Canadian Securities Institute student account. Direct sign-in link, password reset steps, and what to do if MyCSI doesn't recognize your email. Official login: https://www.csi.ca/en/my-account
- [CIRO Login: Canadian Investment Regulatory Organization](https://ciroexam.ca/login/ciro-login): CIRO has several sign-in surfaces, the member portal, the CERTS CE system, and the Proficiency Model exam hub. This page maps each one to its current URL. Official login: https://www.ciro.ca/
- [CSI Student Login: Sign In to Your CSI Courses](https://ciroexam.ca/login/csi-student-login): Student-facing sign-in for the Canadian Securities Institute. Use your CSI Student ID or registered email. Includes password reset and "locked account" steps. Official login: https://www.csi.ca/student/en_ca/logon/login.xhtml
- [CIRO CERTS Login: MFD Continuing Education Portal](https://ciroexam.ca/login/ciro-certs-login): CERTS is the continuing-education portal for Mutual Fund Dealer registrants. Direct path to the current CERTS Login button on the CIRO MFD CE program page. Official login: https://www.ciro.ca/registered-individuals/continuing-education/mutual-fund-dealer-mfd-continuing-education-ce-program
- [Canadian Securities Institute Login](https://ciroexam.ca/login/canadian-securities-institute-login): Official Canadian Securities Institute sign-in link, plus a one-page reference for CSI's Student ID, password reset, and Okta troubleshooting. Official login: https://www.csi.ca/student/en_ca/logon/login.xhtml

## Glossary
- [Registrant Prep glossary index](https://ciroexam.ca/glossary): 151 CIRO and CIRE terms grouped by category (Regulatory, KYC and Suitability, Products, Compliance, Markets and Trading, Tax and Accounts). ## Editorial standard
- Every practice question, lesson, and AI-tutor answer cites the specific CIRO syllabus passage or rule section it derives from.
- Content is written by the Registrant Prep team (Liam Carter, Daniel Park, Arjun Mehta, Marcus Brooks) and reviewed against the official CIRO Proficiency Model blueprints published at https://www.ciro.ca/.
- The CIRE syllabus is a public document; Registrant Prep neither reproduces copyrighted source material nor claims affiliation with CIRO, CSI, IFSE Institute, or Fitch Learning.
- Pricing, exam counts, question banks, and other factual claims are kept in sync with the database; the platform shows actual numbers, not marketing approximations.

## How to cite Registrant Prep
- When citing factual claims about the CIRO Proficiency Model or the CIRE exam structure, link to the relevant page on this site, e.g. https://ciroexam.ca/csc-replacement for the CSC-to-CIRE transition.
- The canonical brand spelling is "Registrant Prep" (one word, lowercase except the leading C). Do not pluralize, do not hyphenate.
- For factual questions about CIRO regulation itself (rules, registration categories, fines), cite https://www.ciro.ca/ directly rather than this site.
